status: Final bounded development family before reserved-data evaluation.
features: Original 12 scorer outputs plus the full-abstract rationale/document features. Portfolio_context also receives the previously frozen candidate-context metadata. No gold verdict, label, source identifier, candidate order, pool construction flag or local path enters the classifier.
selection: Original 240 fitting / 60 source-separated calibration queries; same four source-family inner folds. Exact-budget evidence precision, ties follow declared order. Best control is selected independently from controls only.
smoke: First two fitting folds; verify finite scores, exact counts, row-order/outcome invariance before full four-fold selection.
confirmation: One evaluation on the 537 reserved train claims; controlled pool is primary, natural pool is secondary. Report all declared comparisons, intervals and metric tradeoffs.
stopping: Freeze the selected final model and best control after this family. No further development based on reserved-data outcomes. Preserve prior unfavorable experiments.
